notes: Site is Shopify-hosted (nilkamalhomes.com), direct HTTP fetch worked, no robots.txt Claude-disallow. Enumerated all 629 store collections via /collections.json (3 pages, limit=250) and scanned titles/handles for Bestsellers target terms (best*, popular, trend, favorite, top-pick). Found and validated three distinct, non-alias Bestsellers-family PLPs, each confirmed by two independent exact-count sources: (1) the page's own on-page banner text 'H1 (N products)' rendered server-side, and (2) exhaustive /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination (limit=250) deduped by product id. /collections/best-sellers (SEO title 'Buy Bestseller Furniture Online in India', H1 'BEST SELLERS') = 1 product, furniture-focused. /collections/best-sellers-decor (H1 'Best Sellers') = 8 products, decor-focused -- genuinely different product set from best-sellers (different handle, different count), kept as a separate row per the multi-PLP rule, not merged as an alias. /collections/explore-popular-picks (H1 'Explore Popular Picks') = 42 products -- matches the brief's 'Popular Products/Most Popular' target term, verified as a real filterable product grid, not editorial. Checked and EXCLUDED as non-matches: all 'best-deal-*' / 'best-deals*' collections (7 total) -- these are price-discount 'deal' collections, not popularity/bestseller merchandising (confirmed by content: no bestseller framing, purely discount-oriented, titles like 'Buy Furniture at Best Deals Online'); 'hot-offer-on-curated-top-picks' (0 products, dropped per zero-qty rule); 'collections-top-picks-modular-design' (4 products, a curated modular-furniture-design showcase tied to a sale campaign, not a popularity-based bestseller listing -- excluded, no clear match to Bestsellers target terms). No overarching single 'Bestsellers' parent page exists that these three roll up under, so all three are emitted as flat sibling rows (no is_group) rather than a parent+children structure. No Claude-in-Chrome needed; tier 1 (direct HTTP) sufficed throughout.
